UInt16 tries unsigned16 extraction then original legacy signed32 fallback and wraps; UInt32 signed32 projection/extraction preserves unsigned bits. Existing checked unsigned constructor/SetValue domains and plain signed32 browser transport remain explicit adaptations; invalid JS arguments are not native typed-domain claims. SfxUInt16/32 default factory, implicit copy and concrete Clone use actual shared bases; canonical cintitem/intitem headers reexport existing owners. ScIndentItem default0/Which131, implicit copy retainingWhich and value-based Clone restoring131 serve the real DocPool prerequisite. Native same-type equality ignoresWhich while hash includesWhich; retain original behavior. Existing signed16 implementation and other unported numeric families are unchanged and not certified by this scope. Original localized/metric presentation, diagnostic XML/JSON, native cache/assertion/invalid downcast/thread/lifetime/ABI/full document/config/storage/UI/ODS remain pending/excluded. No generic memory/refcount library, new native build/generator/sanitizer or fake provider/document. Existing metadata history/status preserved, not whole-module parity promotion. WholeCalc/complete affected shared raw100 and related actual consumers required; nextfull121, goalactive.
